name: Soft Suave HR Handbook Orchestrator
description: Coordinates handbook policy-content and document revision-history workers.

skills.name: Handbook policy and procedure lookup
skills.description: Find and explain policy text, procedures, contacts, and consequences from the Employee Handbook.
examples: What are the disciplinary consequences in the Handbook?

skills.name: Handbook document revision history
skills.description: Return the Handbook document's revision count, dates, and modification clause.
examples: When was the latest Handbook revision?
